subject.title: fix: stop selected channel sessions from WebChat

question: Should `sessions.abort({ key, clearQueued: true })` become the supported public protocol contract for discarding queued work in a selected non-global session, rather than keeping queue cleanup private to a Control UI-specific path?
rationale: The branch documents and exposes the option through the gateway protocol and Swift model, so the permanence and scope of destructive cancellation semantics require maintainer intent beyond mechanical correctness.

options.title: Accept the scoped protocol option
options.body: Keep `clearQueued` optional, non-global, and authorization-checked as implemented, with exact-head real behavior proof before merge.

options.title: Keep queue cleanup UI-private
options.body: Remove the public parameter and expose a narrower internal or owner-specific path if maintainers do not want external clients to request queue discard.

recommendation.title: Accept the scoped protocol option
recommendation.body: Keep `clearQueued` optional, non-global, and authorization-checked as implemented, with exact-head real behavior proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the most direct context from the current and superseded implementations, though final protocol direction belongs with the relevant repository owners.
